name: EWWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Stolen outright from a defending champion mid-match, then claimed by a self-proclaimed successor before the belt itself was stolen a second time.

name: EWWF United States Championship
epitaph: Defended in a ladder match against a top contender, saved only by a returning ally's brass knuckles.

name: EWWF Ironman Championship
epitaph: Defended twice, including a bloody Taipei Fist submission match against a three-time former World Champion.

name: EWWF Extreme Championship
epitaph: Changed hands in a two-out-of-three-falls scaffold and steel cage match thirty feet above the ring.

name: EWWF Internet Championship
epitaph: Changed hands twice in three weeks, from a barbed-wire-bat gimmick match to a surprise rollup.

name: EWWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Defended twice by the same champions, the second challenge ending in the challengers' own in-storyline arrest.
